# `Q-5-49` — Invalid draft-mode Value

> `draft-mode` must be `gone`, `unlinked`, or `visible`. Draft pages
> are treated as `gone` instead.

## What this means

`draft-mode` controls how pages marked `draft: true` appear in a
rendered website:

| Value | The draft page | Links to it |
|---|---|---|
| `gone` (default) | blank | removed |
| `unlinked` | rendered, with a "Draft" banner | removed |
| `visible` | rendered, with a "Draft" banner | kept |

Any other value is reported with this warning on each draft page it
applies to, and the page is treated as `gone`:

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
website:
  draft-mode: hidden      # Q-5-49: not one of gone / unlinked / visible
```

`draft-mode` can be set anywhere metadata can — `_quarto.yml` (as
`draft-mode` or `website.draft-mode`), a directory's `_metadata.yml`,
or a page's front matter — so the warning's location points at the
value that applies to the page.

## How to fix it

Change the value to `gone`, `unlinked`, or `visible`.
